[B1] < UserX | 'near' : nils , ... > < Device | ... > $ UserX 'approach' Device => < UserX | 'near' : Device , ... > < Device | ... > .
[B2] < UserX | 'near' : Device , ... > < Device | ... > $ UserX 'leave' Device => < UserX | 'near' : nils , ... > < Device | ... > .
[B3] < UserX | 'near' : Device , 'key' : nils , ... > < Device | 'key' : DeviceKey , ... > $ UserX 'requestKey' Device => < UserX | 'near' : Device , 'key' : FreshKey , ... > < Device | 'key' : FreshKey , ... > .
[B4] < UserX | 'key' : Key , ... > < Cloud | Device : ('trusted' : TrustedUsers , ...) , 'secret' : Secret , ... > $ UserX 'signKey' Cloud | (Device ; Key) => < UserX | 'key' : Key , ... > < Cloud | Device : ('trusted' : TrustedUsers , ...) , 'secret' : Secret , ... > $ Cloud 'signedKey' UserX | (encrypt(Key, Secret)) .
[B4] < UserX | 'signedKey' : nils , ... > $ Cloud 'signedKey' UserX | (SignedKey) => < UserX | 'signedKey' : SignedKey , ... > .
[B5] < UserX | 'near' : Device , 'signedKey' : SignedKey , ... > < Device | 'key' : Key , 'secret' : Secret , 'trusted' : TrustedUsers , ... > $ UserX 'bindDevice' Device | (SignedKey) => < UserX | 'near' : Device , 'signedKey' : SignedKey , ... > < Device | 'key' : Key , 'secret' : Secret , 'trusted' : (UserX , TrustedUsers) , ... > if SignedKey == encrypt(Key, Secret) .
[B6] < Cloud | Device : ('trusted' : TrustedUsers , ...) , ... > $ UserX 'shareAccess' Cloud | (Device ; UserY) => < Cloud | Device : ('trusted' : (UserY , TrustedUsers) , ...) , ... > .
[B7] < Cloud | Device : ('trusted' : (UserX , (UserY , Rest)) , ...) , ... > $ UserX 'revokeAccess' Cloud | (Device ; UserY) => < Cloud | Device : ('trusted' : (UserX , Rest) , ...) , ... > .
